integrity: Exact symbolic identities and seven direct rational matrix cases reproduced; the general statement uses a written proof, not finite enumeration; independently unvalidated.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-size parts with at least three parts and each part size at least two; only Radau IIA completed-step matrix; precise two-root interval remains algebraic rather than radical. Originality subject to incomplete historical indexing.
title: Sharp Radau IIA positivity and reentry on balanced multipartite diffusion networks
